answer.label: absent
answer.rationale: The guard is an Agent.output_validator that renders its verdict only after tool handlers have run (post-run, deterministic 'after'), but the scripted CountingTestModel is configured with call_tools=['sync_notes'], so publish_record is never invoked and the protected records-API http_post never commits under DENY (or any verdict) — the DENY event fires against a tool call that never happened, making the protected effect absent rather than escaping.
